video.title: AI欧腐《西装下的蕾丝/Lace Under Steel My Boss is a Secret Lingerie Enthusiast》
video.desc:
A ruthless CEO wears women's lingerie beneath his power suits. His "ghost" employee—inked, camera-wielding, lethal—discovers the truth. Blackmail becomes seduction. Control becomes obsession. Two masks shatter into one devastating affair. 
一位冷酷无情的 CEO，在象征权力的西装之下，穿着女士内衣。他那位"幽灵"般的员工，满身刺青、手持相机、危险致命，发现了这个秘密。要挟变成了引诱，掌控变成了痴迷。两张面具同时碎裂，化作一场毁灭般的恋情。
